<p data-local-id="ca527f3d2ca5" data-prosemirror-content-type="node" data-prosemirror-node-name="paragraph" data-prosemirror-node-block="true">与此同时，使用了 Clarity 的 Copilot 工具查了一下这几个页面最近的性能，我们可以看到 LCP 上确实存在严重问题，这个体验确实很糟糕：</p>

<p data-local-id="8699aca78cf0" data-prosemirror-content-type="node" data-prosemirror-node-name="paragraph" data-prosemirror-node-block="true">于是，我们开始着手分析：</p>
<div class="mediaSingleView-content-wrap" data-media-vc-wrapper="true" data-prosemirror-content-type="node" data-prosemirror-node-name="mediaSingle" data-prosemirror-node-block="true">
<div class="rich-media-item mediaSingleView-content-wrap image-center" data-node-type="mediaSingle" data-layout="center" data-width="760" data-width-type="pixel" data-media-vc-wrapper="true">
<div>
<div>
<div class="media-content-wrap">
<div title="Attachment" data-id="d3aa233a-71da-4d1e-9ef8-3092162fced5" data-node-type="media" data-client-id="afc0912f-5e67-4a8f-8300-a4b5d9a94c08" data-type="file" data-collection="contentId-509608432" data-width="805" data-height="564" data-alt="image-20260403-075106.png" data-context-id="509608432" data-file-mime-type="image/png" data-file-name="image-20260403-075106.png" data-file-size="209252" data-prosemirror-content-type="node" data-prosemirror-node-name="media" data-prosemirror-node-block="true">&nbsp;</div>
</div>

<p data-local-id="cba51917b002" data-prosemirror-content-type="node" data-prosemirror-node-name="paragraph" data-prosemirror-node-block="true">首先，尝试用 AI 工具 CodeX 分析和解决了下这 2 个页面的问题，并且在晚上上了一个版本。但事实证明，<strong data-prosemirror-content-type="mark" data-prosemirror-mark-name="strong">AI 目前还无法解决前端性能问题</strong>。尽管 AI 版本没能成功解决问题，但是 AI 给出了一些<strong data-prosemirror-content-type="mark" data-prosemirror-mark-name="strong">言之有物</strong>的方向：</p>
<div class="fabric-editor-breakout-mark" data-mode="wide" data-width="760" data-prosemirror-content-type="mark" data-prosemirror-mark-name="breakout">
<div class="code-block--start">&nbsp;</div>
<div class="code-block-content-wrapper">
<div>
<div class="code-block-gutter-pseudo-element" data-label="1

54">&nbsp;</div>

<div class="code-content"><code data-language="markdown" data-testid="code-block--code" data-local-id="194794892bd8">**结论** 卡顿主因不是接口慢，而是点击 `查询` 后前端主线程被宽表渲染/重排卡住了。 **证据** `个人工作量（new） /telecol/report/workload/person` - 主列表接口：`378ms` - 刷新时间接口：`164ms` - 表格真正出现数据：约 `5.4s` - 长任务：`3325ms`、`1644ms` - 额外还夹了站内信轮询、根路径 `fetch`、日志上报 `小组工作量（new） /telecol/report/workload/team` - 主列表接口：`264ms` - 刷新时间接口：`125ms` - 表格真正出现数据：约 `4.6s` - 长任务：`3036ms`、`1259ms` - 还夹了根路径 `fetch` 和 Clarity 上报 这组数据说明： - 网络请求本身很快，核心接口都在 `400ms` 内 - 但用户要等 `4.6s-5.4s` 才看到有效数据 - 中间被两段超长主线程任务卡住，量级是 `3s + 1s`，这就是体感卡顿来源 **怎么理解** 你前面那份线上指标里 `LCP/INP` 高，是合理的。因为真实链路是： 1. 刷新页面 2. 点 `查询` 3. 接口很快返回 4. 前端开始渲染超宽动态表 5. 主线程被长任务占住，页面长时间不响应 所以这不是“菜单切换壳层慢”，也不是“单纯接口慢”，而是“查询触发后的页面渲染太重”。 **顺带确认的一点** 线上当前版本在点 `查询` 时，仍然会额外请求一次 `refresh-time`。这说明我本地刚做的“把 `latestRefreshTime` 从首屏/查询链路后移”的优化，线上还没生效。 **下一步建议** 优先级直接这样排： 1. 先上本地已做的减法 - `refresh-time` 延后 - 组织树选择器按需请求 - 宽表不再用 `x: 'max-content'` 2. 继续压表格渲染成本 - 默认少渲染列 - 给动态列稳定宽度 - 把低频列折叠 - 评估表体虚拟滚动 3. 下一轮要抓 flame chart - 现在已经证明“慢在主线程” - 下一步不是再猜，而是定位这 `3s` 长任务到底耗在 `ProTable`、列计算、还是 DOM layout</code></div>
</div>
<div class="code-block--end">&nbsp;</div>
</div>
<p data-local-id="6db036cfc1f0" data-prosemirror-content-type="node" data-prosemirror-node-name="paragraph" data-prosemirror-node-block="true">于是第二天我们不得不手动 DEBUG 解决问题，并开启“人工”智能分析。</p>
<h2 data-local-id="dfa5ed2828bf" data-prosemirror-content-type="node" data-prosemirror-node-name="heading" data-prosemirror-node-block="true">根因定位 Why?</h2>
<h3 data-local-id="c0172255cec3" data-prosemirror-content-type="node" data-prosemirror-node-name="heading" data-prosemirror-node-block="true">具体步骤</h3>
<ul class="ak-ul" data-local-id="5e0d51253a86" data-prosemirror-content-type="node" data-prosemirror-node-name="bulletList" data-prosemirror-node-block="true">
<li data-local-id="352f52d2f5af" data-prosemirror-content-type="node" data-prosemirror-node-name="listItem" data-prosemirror-node-block="true">
<p data-local-id="c1cc45fa170b" data-prosemirror-content-type="node" data-prosemirror-node-name="paragraph" data-prosemirror-node-block="true">无论是 MacOS 还是 Windows OS 这个卡顿感都是明显可见的，说明跟操作系统 OS 无关</p>
</li>
<li data-local-id="746bd421a63b" data-prosemirror-content-type="node" data-prosemirror-node-name="listItem" data-prosemirror-node-block="true">
<p data-local-id="a4a6208acb9c" data-prosemirror-content-type="node" data-prosemirror-node-name="paragraph" data-prosemirror-node-block="true">然后让坐席用 Chrome 浏览器登录和我们测试用 Chrome 浏览器登录，发现卡顿感也是明显可见的，说明跟浏览器及其版本无关</p>
</li>
<li data-local-id="f666bfd2401c" data-prosemirror-content-type="node" data-prosemirror-node-name="listItem" data-prosemirror-node-block="true">
<p data-local-id="4a1aae5e1a64" data-prosemirror-content-type="node" data-prosemirror-node-name="paragraph" data-prosemirror-node-block="true">然后接口的返回速度也很正常都是 100～300ms 内返回了数据，说明这跟后端的接口速度无关</p>
</li>
<li data-local-id="10ffa4f19788" data-prosemirror-content-type="node" data-prosemirror-node-name="listItem" data-prosemirror-node-block="true">
<p data-local-id="41c6148a8b6d" data-prosemirror-content-type="node" data-prosemirror-node-name="paragraph" data-prosemirror-node-block="true">最后这些页面的共性是都是宽表，横向有许多列，大概有 40 列，虽然数据分页后只有 20 条，说明这<strong data-prosemirror-content-type="mark" data-prosemirror-mark-name="strong">跟页面表格渲染</strong>有关，最后结果也验证了这一点</p>
</li>
</ul>

<h3 data-local-id="f9a579ae9a21" data-prosemirror-content-type="node" data-prosemirror-node-name="heading" data-prosemirror-node-block="true">Chrome Devtools Performance Panel</h3>
<p data-local-id="1bd666c12df5" data-prosemirror-content-type="node" data-prosemirror-node-name="paragraph" data-prosemirror-node-block="true">在 的反馈中有一个关键线索是 “<strong data-prosemirror-content-type="mark" data-prosemirror-mark-name="strong">一旦页面开始渲染，点击 tab 切换无响应，造成卡顿感强烈</strong>”：</p>
<div class="mediaSingleView-content-wrap" data-media-vc-wrapper="true" data-prosemirror-content-type="node" data-prosemirror-node-name="mediaSingle" data-prosemirror-node-block="true">

实测：卡顿感极其强烈
<div>
<div class="media-content-wrap">&nbsp;</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-local-id="04dc1272f240" data-prosemirror-content-type="node" data-prosemirror-node-name="paragraph" data-prosemirror-node-block="true">于是，我们开始通过 Chrome Devtools 的 Perfromance Panel 面板手动抓取<strong data-prosemirror-content-type="mark" data-prosemirror-mark-name="strong">上述操作路径依赖</strong>中 JS 的执行帧火焰图 (Flame Chart)，分析引发卡顿感的根源：</p>
<div class="mediaSingleView-content-wrap" data-media-vc-wrapper="true" data-prosemirror-content-type="node" data-prosemirror-node-name="mediaSingle" data-prosemirror-node-block="true">

火焰图
<div>
<div class="media-content-wrap">&nbsp;</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-local-id="e8fe38689e57" data-prosemirror-content-type="node" data-prosemirror-node-name="paragraph" data-prosemirror-node-block="true">从图中左下角可以发现其中主要卡顿点在 JS 执行线程跟浏览器的渲染线程上，我们再细化一下，只选中红色的 LongTask 看看究竟是啥导致了“<strong data-prosemirror-content-type="mark" data-prosemirror-mark-name="strong"><span class="fabric-text-color-mark" data-text-custom-color="#ff5630" data-prosemirror-content-type="mark" data-prosemirror-mark-name="textColor">卡顿</span></strong>”问题的发生：</p>
<div class="mediaSingleView-content-wrap" data-media-vc-wrapper="true" data-prosemirror-content-type="node" data-prosemirror-node-name="mediaSingle" data-prosemirror-node-block="true">
<div class="rich-media-item mediaSingleView-content-wrap image-center" data-node-type="mediaSingle" data-layout="center" data-width="760" data-width-type="pixel" data-media-vc-wrapper="true">
<div>
<div>

</div>
Why? 原来是 "Recalculate Style" performance issues
<div>
<div class="media-content-wrap">&nbsp;</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<h3 data-local-id="5dbc4156ffde" data-prosemirror-content-type="node" data-prosemirror-node-name="heading" data-prosemirror-node-block="true">Why?</h3>
<p data-local-id="4133914fa258" data-prosemirror-content-type="node" data-prosemirror-node-name="paragraph" data-prosemirror-node-block="true">是什么导致了这个问题？<strong data-prosemirror-content-type="mark" data-prosemirror-mark-name="strong">Recalculate Style</strong></p>
<p data-local-id="4133914fa258" data-prosemirror-content-type="node" data-prosemirror-node-name="paragraph" data-prosemirror-node-block="true"><strong data-prosemirror-content-type="mark" data-prosemirror-mark-name="strong"><img alt="image" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1162673/202604/1162673-20260403173424002-1770026088.png" class="lazyload"></strong></p>
<div class="mediaSingleView-content-wrap" data-media-vc-wrapper="true" data-prosemirror-content-type="node" data-prosemirror-node-name="mediaSingle" data-prosemirror-node-block="true">
<div class="rich-media-item mediaSingleView-content-wrap image-center" data-node-type="mediaSingle" data-layout="center" data-width="664" data-width-type="pixel" data-media-vc-wrapper="true">
<div>
<div>
<div class="media-content-wrap">
<div title="Attachment" data-id="292eb9f5-1929-447a-b022-914b4a4f50c6" data-node-type="media" data-client-id="afc0912f-5e67-4a8f-8300-a4b5d9a94c08" data-type="file" data-collection="contentId-509608432" data-width="664" data-height="947" data-alt="image-20260403-085030.png" data-context-id="509608432" data-file-mime-type="image/png" data-file-name="image-20260403-085030.png" data-file-size="443528" data-prosemirror-content-type="node" data-prosemirror-node-name="media" data-prosemirror-node-block="true">&nbsp;</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-local-id="82fad1a85e4c" data-prosemirror-content-type="node" data-prosemirror-node-name="paragraph" data-prosemirror-node-block="true">在它之上还有概念叫 Reflow：<strong data-prosemirror-content-type="mark" data-prosemirror-mark-name="strong">Reflow</strong> 属于“重新渲染”过程中的一个关键步骤，即<strong data-prosemirror-content-type="mark" data-prosemirror-mark-name="strong">重排布局</strong>。当页面布局发生变化时，浏览器会先进行 <strong data-prosemirror-content-type="mark" data-prosemirror-mark-name="strong">Reflow</strong> (重新算位置)，然后紧接着进行 <strong data-prosemirror-content-type="mark" data-prosemirror-mark-name="strong">Repaint</strong> (重新画到屏幕上)。</p>
<p data-local-id="82fad1a85e4c" data-prosemirror-content-type="node" data-prosemirror-node-name="paragraph" data-prosemirror-node-block="true"><img alt="image" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1162673/202604/1162673-20260403173501692-1462718865.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<div class="mediaSingleView-content-wrap" data-media-vc-wrapper="true" data-prosemirror-content-type="node" data-prosemirror-node-name="mediaSingle" data-prosemirror-node-block="true">
<div class="rich-media-item mediaSingleView-content-wrap image-center" data-node-type="mediaSingle" data-layout="center" data-width="667" data-width-type="pixel" data-media-vc-wrapper="true">
<div>
<div>
<div class="media-content-wrap">
<div title="Attachment" data-id="c0672b7a-64ba-4ade-a882-c031681c287c" data-node-type="media" data-client-id="afc0912f-5e67-4a8f-8300-a4b5d9a94c08" data-type="file" data-collection="contentId-509608432" data-width="667" data-height="826" data-alt="image-20260403-084954.png" data-context-id="509608432" data-file-mime-type="image/png" data-file-name="image-20260403-084954.png" data-file-size="337565" data-media-trace-id="8adcfdf4fc8ca7a0" data-prosemirror-content-type="node" data-prosemirror-node-name="media" data-prosemirror-node-block="true">&nbsp;</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-local-id="d4c1a425b8e4" data-prosemirror-content-type="node" data-prosemirror-node-name="paragraph" data-prosemirror-node-block="true">所以根据上述分析我们可以得出如下结论：<strong data-prosemirror-content-type="mark" data-prosemirror-mark-name="strong"><span class="fabric-text-color-mark" data-text-custom-color="#ff5630" data-prosemirror-content-type="mark" data-prosemirror-mark-name="textColor">浏览器的渲染耗时极高，而且它一边计算（执行 JS）一遍重排（Reflow &gt; Recalculate &gt; Repaint）</span></strong>。</p>
<h3 data-local-id="22dd44d529a3" data-prosemirror-content-type="node" data-prosemirror-node-name="heading" data-prosemirror-node-block="true">Which？</h3>
<p data-local-id="4b9ef9102118" data-prosemirror-content-type="node" data-prosemirror-node-name="paragraph" data-prosemirror-node-block="true">那究竟是什么导致了它一直 <strong data-prosemirror-content-type="mark" data-prosemirror-mark-name="strong"><span class="fabric-text-color-mark" data-text-custom-color="#ff5630" data-prosemirror-content-type="mark" data-prosemirror-mark-name="textColor">Reflow</span></strong> 呢？点进去这个火焰区块发现：</p>
<p data-local-id="4b9ef9102118" data-prosemirror-content-type="node" data-prosemirror-node-name="paragraph" data-prosemirror-node-block="true"><img alt="image" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1162673/202604/1162673-20260403173512352-1580270193.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<div class="mediaSingleView-content-wrap" data-media-vc-wrapper="true" data-prosemirror-content-type="node" data-prosemirror-node-name="mediaSingle" data-prosemirror-node-block="true">
<div class="rich-media-item mediaSingleView-content-wrap image-center" data-node-type="mediaSingle" data-layout="center" data-width="760" data-width-type="pixel" data-media-vc-wrapper="true">
<div>
<div>
<div class="media-content-wrap">
<div title="Attachment" data-id="1a174e42-3164-43eb-997e-7d6abf59a745" data-node-type="media" data-client-id="afc0912f-5e67-4a8f-8300-a4b5d9a94c08" data-type="file" data-collection="contentId-509608432" data-width="2785" data-height="1141" data-alt="image-20260403-085604.png" data-context-id="509608432" data-file-mime-type="image/png" data-file-name="image-20260403-085604.png" data-file-size="853358" data-prosemirror-content-type="node" data-prosemirror-node-name="media" data-prosemirror-node-block="true">&nbsp;</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-local-id="a6b99211b644" data-prosemirror-content-type="node" data-prosemirror-node-name="paragraph" data-prosemirror-node-block="true">找到了是 <span class="code" data-prosemirror-content-type="mark" data-prosemirror-mark-name="code">isEleEllipsis</span> 这个方法。那这个方法是干嘛的？为什么？继续点进去：</p>
<div class="mediaSingleView-content-wrap" data-media-vc-wrapper="true" data-prosemirror-content-type="node" data-prosemirror-node-name="mediaSingle" data-prosemirror-node-block="true">
<div class="rich-media-item mediaSingleView-content-wrap image-center" data-node-type="mediaSingle" data-layout="center" data-width="721" data-width-type="pixel" data-media-vc-wrapper="true">
<div>
<div>
<div>
<div class="media-content-wrap">
<div title="Attachment" data-id="8087ca1d-f9e9-4238-b500-3dc096f15406" data-node-type="media" data-client-id="afc0912f-5e67-4a8f-8300-a4b5d9a94c08" data-type="file" data-collection="contentId-509608432" data-width="721" data-height="599" data-alt="image-20260403-085905.png" data-context-id="509608432" data-file-mime-type="image/png" data-file-name="image-20260403-085905.png" data-file-size="308743" data-prosemirror-content-type="node" data-prosemirror-node-name="media" data-prosemirror-node-block="true"><img alt="image" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1162673/202604/1162673-20260403173518657-1147349755.png" class="lazyload"></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
罪魁祸首
<div>
<div class="media-content-wrap">&nbsp;</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-local-id="517477ccb72a" data-prosemirror-content-type="node" data-prosemirror-node-name="paragraph" data-prosemirror-node-block="true">这个方法的执行居然花了近 100ms ！而且这个代码看起来是 ant-design 的代码！要去提 ISSUE 了，见 <span class="inlineCardView-content-wrap inlineNodeView" data-prosemirror-content-type="node" data-prosemirror-node-name="inlineCard" data-prosemirror-node-inline="true"><span class="card"><a href="https://github.com/ant-design/ant-design/issues/57563" data-inline-card="" data-card-data="" data-local-id="9f9f3a5ad57e" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/ant-design/ant-design/issues/57563</a></span></span></p>
<p data-local-id="0caa8005180b" data-prosemirror-content-type="node" data-prosemirror-node-name="paragraph" data-prosemirror-node-block="true">如果界面上有 20 rows * 40 columns = 800 cells，那么久导致了 800 * 100ms = 8s 左右的卡顿和延迟，这体验确实极差。</p>
<p data-local-id="4622ee0e76a0" data-prosemirror-content-type="node" data-prosemirror-node-name="paragraph" data-prosemirror-node-block="true">&nbsp;</p>
<h2 data-local-id="6718e3d792cd" data-prosemirror-content-type="node" data-prosemirror-node-name="heading" data-prosemirror-node-block="true">设计解决方案 How？</h2>
<h3 data-local-id="7ca67b6728f3" data-prosemirror-content-type="node" data-prosemirror-node-name="heading" data-prosemirror-node-block="true">临时解决方案</h3>
<p data-local-id="420549bf0cf3" data-prosemirror-content-type="node" data-prosemirror-node-name="paragraph" data-prosemirror-node-block="true">禁用 <span class="code" data-prosemirror-content-type="mark" data-prosemirror-mark-name="code">ellipsis: true</span> 配置，全部删除或注释掉。</p>
<p data-local-id="420549bf0cf3" data-prosemirror-content-type="node" data-prosemirror-node-name="paragraph" data-prosemirror-node-block="true"><img alt="image" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1162673/202604/1162673-20260403173530778-1322420170.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h3 data-local-id="3883d3dfc6bd" data-prosemirror-content-type="node" data-prosemirror-node-name="heading" data-prosemirror-node-block="true">长期解决方案</h3>
<p data-local-id="423cfada81a3" data-prosemirror-content-type="node" data-prosemirror-node-name="paragraph" data-prosemirror-node-block="true">尝试升级 ant-design 的版本，看新版本是否有解决这个问题。若有，则无事发生。若无，则维持临时解决方案，且<strong data-prosemirror-content-type="mark" data-prosemirror-mark-name="strong">非必要不再使用</strong> <span class="code" data-prosemirror-content-type="mark" data-prosemirror-mark-name="code">ellipsis</span> <strong data-prosemirror-content-type="mark" data-prosemirror-mark-name="strong">属性</strong>。</p>
<p data-local-id="a72c406305db" data-prosemirror-content-type="node" data-prosemirror-node-name="paragraph" data-prosemirror-node-block="true">&nbsp;</p>
<h2 data-local-id="92c42c031afe" data-prosemirror-content-type="node" data-prosemirror-node-name="heading" data-prosemirror-node-block="true">测试解决方案</h2>
<p data-local-id="da723ee73bfa" data-prosemirror-content-type="node" data-prosemirror-node-name="paragraph" data-prosemirror-node-block="true">使用上述解决方案后，经测试，性能变好，切换很快，符合预期。</p>
<div class="mediaSingleView-content-wrap" data-media-vc-wrapper="true" data-prosemirror-content-type="node" data-prosemirror-node-name="mediaSingle" data-prosemirror-node-block="true">
<div class="rich-media-item mediaSingleView-content-wrap image-center" data-node-type="mediaSingle" data-layout="center" data-width="760" data-width-type="pixel" data-media-vc-wrapper="true">
<div>
<div>
<div class="media-content-wrap">
<div title="Attachment" data-id="1af6acdc-027c-40c7-81db-030d8d02fcc2" data-node-type="media" data-client-id="afc0912f-5e67-4a8f-8300-a4b5d9a94c08" data-type="file" data-collection="contentId-509608432" data-width="5922" data-height="1494" data-alt="20260403171427_rec_.mp4" data-context-id="509608432" data-file-mime-type="video/mp4" data-file-name="20260403171427_rec_.mp4" data-file-size="7973688" data-prosemirror-content-type="node" data-prosemirror-node-name="media" data-prosemirror-node-block="true">&nbsp;</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-local-id="ca7a1fcc1645" data-prosemirror-content-type="node" data-prosemirror-node-name="paragraph" data-prosemirror-node-block="true">回顾上述提到的 AI 给出的提示中的第三步：</p>
<div class="fabric-editor-breakout-mark" data-mode="wide" data-width="760" data-prosemirror-content-type="mark" data-prosemirror-mark-name="breakout">
<div class="code-block--start">&nbsp;</div>
<div class="code-block-content-wrapper">
<div>
<div class="code-block-gutter-pseudo-element" data-label="1
2
3">&nbsp;</div>
</div>
<div class="code-content"><code data-language="markdown" data-testid="code-block--code" data-local-id="4cfc926caba0">3. 下一轮要抓 flame chart - 现在已经证明“慢在主线程” - 下一步不是再猜，而是定位这 `3s` 长任务到底耗在 `ProTable`、列计算、还是 DOM layout</code></div>
</div>
<div class="code-block--end">&nbsp;</div>
</div>
<p data-local-id="60792689f2a5" data-prosemirror-content-type="node" data-prosemirror-node-name="paragraph" data-prosemirror-node-block="true">问题出现在 <strong data-prosemirror-content-type="mark" data-prosemirror-mark-name="strong">列计算 + DOM layout</strong>。</p>
<p data-local-id="a5a9a96c0ba9" data-prosemirror-content-type="node" data-prosemirror-node-name="paragraph" data-prosemirror-node-block="true">&nbsp;</p>
<p data-local-id="087297914ce9" data-prosemirror-content-type="node" data-prosemirror-node-name="paragraph" data-prosemirror-node-block="true">AI 时代，前端已经离失业不远了，都要转全栈偏前了 🤣。朋友们，为什么前端最先被替代？因为这是互联网时代最 open 的职业，没有之一。</p>
<p data-local-id="acb651135767" data-prosemirror-content-type="node" data-prosemirror-node-name="paragraph" data-prosemirror-node-block="true">&nbsp;</p>
<h2 data-local-id="42c2daf7432d" data-prosemirror-content-type="node" data-prosemirror-node-name="heading" data-prosemirror-node-block="true">用户反馈</h2>
<p data-local-id="84c5ebcc44b3" data-prosemirror-content-type="node" data-prosemirror-node-name="paragraph" data-prosemirror-node-block="true">将解决方案上线后，用户反馈也不卡了。</p>

<h2 data-local-id="42143999b4c0" data-prosemirror-content-type="node" data-prosemirror-node-name="heading" data-prosemirror-node-block="true">致谢</h2>
<p data-local-id="2004263f755d" data-prosemirror-content-type="node" data-prosemirror-node-name="paragraph" data-prosemirror-node-block="true">这个问题的妥善解决，离不开业务同学的反馈，领导的支持，还有同事的建议，测试的帮助。</p>
